messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

The relation 'manufacturer' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is produced or manufactured by the company specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
B. 'manufacturer location': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by a company located in the place specified by the object entity.
C. 'has brand name': The subject drug is marketed under the brand or trade name specified by the object entity.
D. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
E. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
